name: CoW
fix_description: uniswapV3SwapCallback (0xfa461e33) has no msg.sender validation. Anyone can call this callback pretending to be a Uniswap V3 pool, causing the contract to transfer tokens to the caller. Fix: verify msg.sender is the expected pool address computed from factory + token pair + fee.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is essentially a single direct call into an exposed callback with attacker-controlled calldata, followed by unwrapping WETH and withdrawing funds. It uses no flash loan, no complex routing, and requires minimal protocol-specific reasoning beyond noticing the unsafe callback/invocation pattern.
